dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype (non-GCB, ABC-like by Hans algorithm

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III-B (Lugano 2014), with splenic involvement (III-S) and bulky disease.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: I am treating the spleen as a nodal (S) site per Lugano.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: fevers to 38.1-38.5 C (38.3 C on 2026-09-17) and drenching night sweats.

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic lesions were classed as extranodal, this would be stage IV-B.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma and the high-grade B-cell lymphoma category does not apply

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III, LDH above ULN) is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: This is the high-risk group, with CNS relapse risk on the order of 10%
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Score of 3 is correct but it is mislabeled as high-risk rather than intermediate.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles of 21 days, with curative intent

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Reasons: non-GCB and high-IPI disease, where POLARIX showed a PFS benefit for pola-R-CHP over R-CHP

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Consolidative involved-site radiotherapy (about 30-36 Gy) to the retroperitoneal mass only if there is residual PET-avid bulky disease at end of treatment

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now and continue for at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA and LFTs; start entecavir

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no routine CNS prophylaxis (no intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate).
cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.note: Correctly omits prophylaxis/MRI/LP but calls the risk high rather than intermediate.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3-6 weeks after cycle 6 is the primary response assessment. Complete metabolic response is Deauville 1-3

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Residual FDG uptake at end of treatment is not by itself a reason for biopsy unless the mass is growing or new disease appears.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 1-2 days before cycle 1 (febuxostat acceptable), oral hydration 2-3 L per day

sup_gcsf.quote: G-CSF: primary prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim or biosimilar on day 4

fit_full_dose.quote: Fit for full-dose curative therapy without empiric dose reduction

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA and current LFTs not in the chart
